claims.behavior: The duplicates preparation tab's cog menu has regenerate search tree (do it/forget it), regenerate search numbers and resync potential duplicate pairs to storage with the reference's questions; the resync drops pairs of groups whose best file left local storage, stops searching it and reports in a popup.
limits: Regenerating the tree and numbers is a refresh: hydrus-rs keeps no tree or count cache.
The resync popup is not cancellable with progress.

validation_review.reason: Tree and number cache actions are accepted no-ops; cited synthetic resync helper test does not replay menus/questions/cancellation or prove live consumer/preservation behavior.
